title: Design System: Kyle Young Engineering Portfolio

label.purpose: Project IDs, dates, tools, categories, and measurement labels.

motion.name: archive-reveal
motion.purpose: One restrained reveal language for major content.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Hard-edged ink CTA for the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #111315; background: #111315; color: #fffdf8; font-family: 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 900; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #17384e; border-color: #17384e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(180, 101, 39, 0.58); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Archive Row
components.html: 05Phoenix 2024FRC Crescendo robot / subsystem integration
components.css: .ds-index-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px minmax(180px, .32fr) 1fr; gap: 16px; align-items: baseline; padding: 16px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(17,19,21,.18); color: #111315; text-decoration: none; } .ds-index-row span { color: #315f7c; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-index-row strong { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.16rem; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-index-row em { color: #5b6268; font-style: normal; }

components.name: Metadata Grid
components.description: Hairline metadata cells for role, tools, dates, and outcomes.
components.css: .ds-meta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; margin: 0; padding: 1px; background: rgba(17,19,21,.18); } .ds-meta div { padding: 12px; background: rgba(255,253,248,.72); } .ds-meta dt { color: #315f7c; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-meta dd { margin: 6px 0 0; color: #111315; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.25; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is a technical publication before it is a resume. It should feel like a contemporary engineering journal and premium case-study archive: off-white paper, charcoal type, muted UCLA-blue structure, copper proof marks, visible grids, numbered projects, compact metadata, and large real artifacts.
keyCharacteristics: Monumental Archivo display type contrasted with compact JetBrains Mono metadata.
Off-white/charcoal surfaces with muted UCLA blue as the structural accent.
Square, hairline-bounded modules instead of rounded card stacks.
Real project imagery, CAD, plots, equations, posters, and photos as primary visual anchors.

rules.name: The Proof-First Color Rule
rules.body: Blue and copper mark structure or evidence; they do not decorate empty space.

rules.name: The Paper-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: The portfolio should still work if all accent color is removed; hierarchy comes first from scale, alignment, and content.

rules.name: The Mono Means Metadata Rule
rules.body: Use monospaced text for IDs, categories, tools, dates, and measurement labels only.

rules.name: The Hairline Archive Rule
rules.body: Borders and grid seams define the system; avoid soft shadow stacks unless a control truly needs overlay behavior.

dos: Do rank project evidence visibly; the strongest work should not look like every other entry.
Do use actual CAD, plots, equations, posters, and hardware photos as major visual anchors.
Do preserve factual uncertainty by labeling content gaps instead of inventing numbers or outcomes.
Do keep project pages structured around contribution, process, evidence, outcome, and reflection.
donts: Don't use generic rounded portfolio cards, glass panels, colorful icon grids, or decorative gradients.
Don't bury case-study links under equal card stacks.
Don't use monospaced text as technical costume for ordinary prose.
Don't invent metrics, tools, dates, responsibilities, or research outcomes.
